videos.title: One Of The Best BJJ Half Guard Sweeps (The Coyote Half Guard) by Lucas Leite
videos.whyUseful: Lucas Leite, the creator of the Coyote Guard, demonstrates the core mechanics of the underhook and sweep system used to transition from half guard to a dominant top position. Essential viewing for understanding the original system.

videos.title: Secret to Coyote Half Guard from Half Guard Using Your Shoulder, NOT Elbow - Mica Galvao
videos.whyUseful: Mica Galvao details the crucial shoulder pressure nuance that makes the Coyote guard effective, explaining why using your shoulder instead of your elbow is vital for control and preventing the opponent from flattening you.
